purpose: Verify permitted billing responsibility values (visitor, indenter, institute, project).
action_or_input: Submit booking with billing_responsibility in [visitor, indenter, institute, project].
expected_result: Requisition accepted and persisted with specified billing responsibility.

purpose: Verify refusal of unpermitted billing responsibility value.
preconditions: Booking payload with invalid billing responsibility.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal; action refused.

purpose: Verify offline bookings follow same approval routing as online requests.
action_or_input: Route offline booking through forward and incharge approval.
expected_result: Offline booking transitions pending -> forwarded -> approved.

purpose: Verify offline bookings are subject to same room availability check.
preconditions: Rooms fully booked for date range.
action_or_input: Query room availability for requested dates.

purpose: Verify offline bookings are clearly flagged for audit and reporting.
expected_result: is_offline is True and booking_source in [telephonic, walk_in].

purpose: Verify cancellation charge is calculated according to the stated schedule.
preconditions: Approved booking with daily rate Decimal(600.00).
action_or_input: Compute cancellation charge for given cancellation timing.
expected_result: Accurate charge calculated based on days prior to arrival.

purpose: Verify cancellation occurring exactly 7 days before arrival has 0% charge.
preconditions: Arrival is exactly 7 days from today.

purpose: Verify cancellation occurring within 7 days before arrival has 25% charge.
Verify same-day cancellation or recorded no-show has 50% charge.
preconditions: Arrival is today or no-show recorded.
action_or_input: Submit cancellation request on arrival day.

purpose: Verify billing information is adjusted according to confirmed modification.
preconditions: Stay duration modified from 1 day to 3 days.
expected_result: Bill room rent reflects 3 days at tariff rate.

purpose: Verify billing information adjusted using confirmed cancellation charge.
preconditions: Cancelled booking with 50% charge of 800.00 daily rate.

purpose: Verify room allotment is permitted when booking is in Approved state.
preconditions: Booking status is Approved and room is active/available.

purpose: Verify room allotment is prohibited when booking is not Approved.
preconditions: Booking status is pending or rejected.
action_or_input: Attempt to allot room to non-approved booking.
expected_result: Action refused with HTTP 409 Conflict / 422 Unprocessable Entity.

purpose: Verify Single occupancy records are supported.
Verify Double occupancy records are supported.
Verify Suite room records are supported.
Verify Non-suite room records are supported.
Verify no-show alert generated when expected guest has not checked in.
preconditions: Booking arrival date/time has passed with no checkin.

purpose: Verify overstay alert generated when stay exceeds approved duration.
preconditions: Checked-in booking whose departure date has passed.

purpose: Verify visitor category values A, B, C, D are permitted.
action_or_input: Submit bookings with visitor_category in [A, B, C, D].
expected_result: All categories successfully accepted and stored.

purpose: Verify visitor category outside A, B, C, D is rejected.
Verify tariff selected using category, occupancy, and effective date.
preconditions: Tariff configuration exists for Category A Single.
action_or_input: Calculate room rent for Category A Single stay.
expected_result: Accurate tariff rate matched and applied to bill.

purpose: Verify tariff changes do not affect already generated historical bills.
preconditions: Finalized bill exists based on old tariff.
action_or_input: Add new tariff with updated rate.

purpose: Verify meal bookings permitted for guests currently staying in VH.
Verify meal bookings prohibited for guests not staying in VH.
preconditions: Booking is in pending or rejected or checked_out state.

purpose: Verify individual meal options restricted to Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.
action_or_input: Record meal with individual_type in [breakfast, lunch, dinner].

purpose: Verify unpermitted individual meal option is rejected.
Verify add-on options restricted to Tea and Milk.
action_or_input: Record meal with add_on_type in [tea, milk].

purpose: Verify unpermitted add-on option is rejected.
Verify meal booking date within stay duration is accepted.
Verify meal booking date outside stay duration is rejected.
Verify recorded meal bookings are included in VHMS billing.
expected_result: Bill contains meal line items and meal_charge_total.

purpose: Verify VHMS generates bills based on room rent.
expected_result: Bill contains room_rent_total matching stay days * rate.

purpose: Verify VHMS generates bills based on meal consumption.
expected_result: Bill total includes meal consumption total.

purpose: Verify VHMS generates bills based on applicable cancellation charges.
expected_result: Bill total equals cancellation charge total.

purpose: Verify settlement is recorded as offline cash settlement.
Verify VHMS maintains immutable billing records for audit.
Verify alert generated when quantity falls below minimum threshold.
preconditions: Item quantity reduced below minimum threshold.

purpose: Verify no alert generated when quantity is at or above minimum threshold.
preconditions: Item quantity at or above threshold.

purpose: Verify inventory threshold alert triggers system-generated notification.
expected_result: Notification event dispatched for threshold alert.

purpose: Verify exactly one active Caretaker is maintained at a time.
expected_result: Caretaker A is deactivated, Caretaker B is active; active count is 1.

purpose: Verify exactly one active VH In-Charge is maintained at a time.
expected_result: In-Charge A is deactivated, In-Charge B is active; active count is 1.

purpose: Verify Caretaker and In-Charge role assignments are time-bound.
action_or_input: POST to /api/v1/vh/roles/reassign/ with valid_from and valid_to.
expected_result: Role holder saved with valid_from and valid_to timestamps.

purpose: Verify role reassignment takes effect immediately.
action_or_input: Query current active role holder immediately.
expected_result: Newly assigned user is immediately active.

purpose: Verify transfer of pending records to newly assigned role holder.
preconditions: Pending bookings exist awaiting Caretaker review.
expected_result: New Caretaker accesses and processes pending bookings.

purpose: Verify transfer of ongoing records to newly assigned role holder.
preconditions: Ongoing checked-in stays exist under old Caretaker.
expected_result: New Caretaker manages stays and processes checkout and billing.
